name: sparkles-text

frames.best_why: Several four-point stars are visible at once above and between the letters of the heading.

tagline: Tiny lilac and pink stars twinkle around a bold heading.
summary: A heavy heading with a handful of small four-point stars scattered over and around it, each fading and scaling in and out at random spots so the text keeps glittering.
appearance: The words sit large and bold in white on black, with a few very small four-point stars in purple and pink dotted around the letters. The stars are much smaller than the type and easy to overlook.
behaviour: Each star shrinks to nothing and grows back at a slightly different moment, at random positions over the text, and the set is periodically replaced so new spots light up.
search_phrases: four point stars near a title
use_when: A short heading needs a light magical accent without a full background effect.
avoid_when: Formal or data-heavy screens; the twinkling stars read as playful decoration.
customise: Pass the words as children and set sparklesCount and the two colours; the size comes from the class name and the star shape is fixed in the source.
weight_why: About ten small SVG stars animating on repeat, plus a 100ms interval that reshuffles them.

a11y.note: The decorative stars are not hidden from assistive tech, and the twinkle loop and star shuffling ignore reduced-motion.

issues: The sparkles are tiny and sparse, so the effect is easy to miss.
polish_why: Crisp heading, but the sparkles are too small and few to register strongly.
title: Sparkles Text
